ranks: EDHREC ranks 7181–7451 (the next 60 untriaged by rank), and the 17 stale records whose recorded blockers — improvise, aftermath, embalm, the next untap step skipped by filter — were built since

blocked.name: Indulge // Excess
blocked.why: Aftermath is built; Indulge's trigger lasts the rest of the turn, and Excess counts the creatures you controlled that dealt combat damage to a player this turn, which nothing records.

blocked.name: Blazing Archon
blocked.why: `cantAttackController` protects your planeswalkers too; the ruling says they can still be attacked.

blocked.name: Asylum Visitor
blocked.why: "if that player has no cards in hand" of the upkeep's active player: the hand-size condition reads only you or each player.

blocked.name: Dromoka's Command
blocked.why: Mode 1, "prevent all damage target instant or sorcery spell would deal this turn", has no vocabulary.

blocked.name: Spectra Ward
blocked.why: "This effect doesn't remove Auras": protection from each colour would put every coloured Aura on it, itself included, into the graveyard.

blocked.name: Bog Witch
blocked.why: A mana ability's activation never pays its discard cost (an engine gap — docs/engine-gaps.md).

blocked.name: Warrior's Oath
blocked.why: "At the beginning of that turn's end step, you lose the game": no delayed trigger scoped to the extra turn.

blocked.name: Nicol Bolas, Planeswalker
blocked.why: The −9's "that planeswalker's controller discards seven cards, then sacrifices seven permanents": discard and sacrifice read only a player slot.

blocked.name: Delirium Skeins
blocked.why: Its ruling: each player chooses three cards without seeing the others' choices, then all are discarded at once; a scoped discard discards each player's cards before the next chooses (docs/engine-gaps.md).

blocked.name: Archway of Innovation
blocked.why: "The next spell you cast this turn has improvise": improvise is only a printed field.

blocked.name: Inspiring Statuary
blocked.why: "Nonartifact spells you cast have improvise": improvise is only a printed field.

blocked.name: Cursecloth Wrappings
blocked.why: "Target creature card in your graveyard gains embalm until end of turn": `embalmAbility` is printed-only.

blocked.name: Plague of Vermin
blocked.why: "Each player may pay any amount of life. Repeat this process until no one pays life."

blocked.name: Legion's Initiative
blocked.why: "At the beginning of the next combat, return those cards": no next-combat delayed timing.

blocked.name: Whirlpool Warrior
blocked.why: "Each player shuffles the cards from their hand into their library, then draws that many cards."

blocked.name: Desertion
blocked.why: A countered artifact or creature spell onto the battlefield under your control: `counter`'s `into` is a hand or exile.

blocked.name: The Blue Spirit
blocked.why: "The first creature spell you cast each turn as though it had flash": `castAsThoughFlash` has no first-each-turn form.

blocked.name: Golem-Skin Gauntlets
blocked.why: +1/+0 for each Equipment attached to the equipped creature: `grantPtPerCount` can't count those.

blocked.name: Ugin's Nexus
blocked.why: No replacement that skips extra turns, nor "would be put into a graveyard … instead exile it and take an extra turn".

blocked.name: Magister Sphinx
blocked.why: "Target player's life total becomes 10".

blocked.name: Sin Prodder
blocked.why: "Any opponent may …; if a player does": the first opponent's yes ends it, where `each-player-may` lets each say yes.

blocked.name: Mystic Speculation
blocked.why: Buyback isn't built.

blocked.name: Mindleech Mass
blocked.why: "You may cast a spell from among those cards" from the damaged player's hand: `cast-now` can't name an opponent's hand.

blocked.name: Commit // Memory
blocked.why: Aftermath is built; Memory's "each player shuffles their hand and graveyard into their library" isn't.

blocked.name: Insult // Injury
blocked.why: Aftermath is built; Insult's "damage can't be prevented this turn" isn't.

blocked.name: Ironheart, Clever Champion
blocked.why: "Noncreature spells you cast have improvise": improvise is only a printed field.

blocked.name: Vizier of Many Faces
blocked.why: Embalm is built; the Clone's exception applies only to the embalmed token, and `copyOnEnter` has no such condition.

blocked.name: Leonin Arbiter
blocked.why: "Players can't search libraries", and the {2} special action each player may pay to ignore it.

blocked.name: Colossus of Akros
blocked.why: "As long as this creature is monstrous": nothing reads `monstrous`.

blocked.name: Celebr-8000
blocked.why: Two six-sided dice with a result table per die, and "if you rolled doubles".

blocked.name: O-Naginata
blocked.why: "Can be attached only to a creature with power 3 or greater."

blocked.name: Nature's Chosen
blocked.why: "Tap enchanted creature" as a cost, "activate only if enchanted creature is white and untapped".

blocked.name: Dragon Broodmother
blocked.why: Its Dragon tokens have devour 2, and a token is never asked its devour choice as it's created (docs/engine-gaps.md).

blocked.name: Malignus
blocked.why: Half the highest life total among your opponents, and damage that can't be prevented.

blocked.name: Vesuvan Shapeshifter
blocked.why: Turning itself face down, a copy lasting until then, and the copy choice as it's turned face up.
